# Building up to a half marathon

Shoes should fit with a thumb width of space in front of the longest toe. Increase total distance by about ten percent per week and take a lighter week every month. Sleep is the cheapest recovery tool; a short night shows up in the next workout. Foam rolling and light mobility work help, but they do not replace rest days. Taper for ten days before a half marathon so the legs arrive fresh.
